programs.title: TOTP: 1991
programs.desc: Gary Davies presents the pop chart programme, first broadcast on 23 May 1991 and featuring T'Pau, Simple Minds and Deacon Blue.

programs.title: ...Sings Dylan
programs.desc: Cover versions of Bob Dylan songs by Peter, Paul and Mary, Lulu, The Byrds, Joan Baez, Eric Clapton, Madeleine Peyroux, Bryan Ferry, UB40, Julie Felix and many more.

programs.title: ...Sings Dylan II
programs.desc: Cover versions of Bob Dylan songs from the BBC archives, with Joan Baez, Siouxsie and the Banshees, The Hollies, Adele, Julie Felix, Richie Havens, Bryan Ferry and KT Tunstall.

programs.title: Bob Dylan: Shadow Kingdom
programs.desc: A showcase of Bob Dylan with his band in an intimate setting as he performs songs from his extensive body of work.

programs.title: Tangled Up with Dylan: The Ballad of AJ Weberman
programs.desc: Documentary chronicling the life, times and crimes of Bob Dylan obsessive AJ Weberman. Contains strong language.

programs.title: TOTP: 1999
